mapper.select: select count(*) from sys_user where del_flag = '0' and tenant_id = #{tenantId}

select d.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, count(u.user_id) as userCount from sys_dept d left join sys_user u on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and u.del_flag = '0' and u.tenant_id = d.tenant_id where d.del_flag = '0' and d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} group by d.dept_id, d.dept_name having count(u.user_id) > 0 order by userCount desc, d.dept_id asc limit #{limit}

select notice_id as noticeId, notice_title as title, notice_type as noticeType, create_time as createTime from sys_notice where tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by create_time desc, notice_id desc limit #{limit}
select user_name as userName, ipaddr as ipaddr, login_time as loginTime, status as status from sys_logininfor where tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by login_time desc limit #{limit}
select oper_name as operName, title as title, oper_time as operTime, status as status from sys_oper_log where tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by oper_time desc limit #{limit}

select user_name as userName, tenant_id as tenantId from sys_user where del_flag = '0'
and user_name in
#{userName}
and 1 = 0

select count(distinct t.id) from flow_user u join flow_task t on t.id = u.associated where u.processed_by = #{userId} and u.type in ('1', '2', '3') and u.del_flag = '0' and t.node_type = 1 and t.del_flag = '0'

select distinct t.id as taskId, coalesce(d.flow_code, '') as flowCode, coalesce(d.flow_name, '未命名流程') as flowName, coalesce(nullif(u2.nick_name, ''), nullif(i.create_by, ''), '未知') as initiatorName, coalesce(nullif(t.node_name, ''), '待办') as nodeName, t.create_time as createTime from flow_user u join flow_task t on t.id = u.associated left join flow_definition d on d.id = t.definition_id left join flow_instance i on i.id = t.instance_id left join sys_user u2 on u2.user_id = cast(i.create_by as unsigned) where u.processed_by = #{userId} and u.type in ('1', '2', '3') and u.del_flag = '0' and t.node_type = 1 and t.del_flag = '0' order by t.create_time asc, t.id asc
select count(distinct h.id) from flow_his_task h where h.approver = #{userId} and h.del_flag = '0' and h.node_type in ('1', '3', '4') and h.flow_status <> 'copy'
select count(*) from flow_instance i where i.create_by = #{userId} and i.del_flag = '0'
select count(distinct h.id) from flow_user u join flow_his_task h on h.task_id = u.associated where u.processed_by = #{userId} and u.type = '4' and u.del_flag = '0' and h.del_flag = '0'

select i.id as instanceId, coalesce(d.flow_name, '未命名流程') as flowName, coalesce(nullif(i.node_name, ''), '处理中') as nodeName, (select count(*) from flow_node n where n.definition_id = i.definition_id and n.node_type = 1 and n.del_flag = '0') as totalNodes, (select count(distinct h.node_code) from flow_his_task h where h.instance_id = i.id and h.node_type = 1 and h.flow_status = '2' and h.del_flag = '0') as doneNodes from flow_instance i left join flow_definition d on d.id = i.definition_id where i.create_by = #{userId} and i.flow_status = '1' and i.del_flag = '0' order by i.update_time desc, i.id desc limit 5
select id as definitionId, flow_name as name from flow_definition where is_publish = 1 and del_flag = '0' order by id desc limit #{limit}
